extension.summary: Stremio addons, Xtream IPTV and Telegram streams for Kodi
Addons do Stremio, IPTV Xtream e streams do Telegram para o Kodi
extension.description: Arvio Stream brings the ARVIO experience to Kodi: install Stremio-style addons, add Xtream IPTV accounts, and connect your Telegram account to stream video files from your chats. Add everything fast using QR codes scanned from your phone.

Arvio Stream leva a experiência ARVIO para o Kodi: instale addons do Stremio, adicione contas Xtream de IPTV e conecte sua conta do Telegram para assistir vídeos dos seus chats. Adicione tudo rapidamente usando QR codes escaneados do celular.
extension.disclaimer: You may only use this addon with content you have the legal right to access.
Use este addon somente com conteúdo ao qual você tenha direito legal de acesso.
extension.news: 1.4.9 - Telegram disk-backed adaptive spool: safe bitrate detection, independent progressive pre-download, Android/low-resource profile, protected free-space reserve, transactional STOP cleanup, and conservative single-sender integrity path.
